title: 5 Dollars, National Park Service, United States, 2016
notes: National Museum of American History object record (National Numismatic Collection): 2016 National Park Service 5 dollar proof coin whose obverse shows portraits of John Muir and Theodore Roosevelt. Usage Conditions Apply, so no media staged. Found via NMAH collections search.
